notes:
STATUS is four lists now — Arrivals, Departures, In-house, Moves — each kept for the day from every capture the helper took, so a row that left protel's list is still there, marked as gone since when.

An arrival is marked checked in only when the in-house list shows the same name and room with CI. A departure is marked checked out only when a complete in-house list for that day does not show that name and room, or shows it with CO; a cut-short in-house read proves nothing and says so. A row leaving either list proves nothing on its own — the departure date can be wrong.

The pills in the department check come from these lists and not from the rate list's ledger or an XPS: the departure list draws DEPARTED, the arrival list ARRIVED, both TURNOVER, a moves row with protel's X MOVED. A dot on a departed, turnover or moved pill means a receipt in tonight's report carries that reservation's own name.
